A direct call to     http.ResponseWriter::WriteHeader(statusCode) was made in     SerializeObject() with the original response status code, before     performing the encode. Once this     method is called, it can not again update the status code at a later     time, with say, an erro status code due to encode failure.      - Updated relevant apiserver unit test to reflect the new behavior     (TestWriteJSONDecodeError())      - Add build deps from make update for protobuf serializer

subject: This PR fixes issue #55031 where kubelet.exe crashes on Windows Server Core. The root cause is that kubelet.exe depends on package lxn/win pdh and kernel32 wrapper for node metrics. However, opengl32.dll is not available in Server Core and lxn/win requires the presence of all win32 DLLs. This PR uses a slim win32 package JeffAshton/win_pdh since most win32 APIs needed are PDH API. Also this PR makes own implementation of GetPhysicallyInstalledSystemMemory until golang Windows syscall has it or lxn/win fixes opengl32 issue. Also this PR modifies the way to get Windows version.
